purpose: Equal-wall-clock physical target-machine crossover measurement among the accepted exact alternating control, CCS sampled challenger and ES_ZERO sampled control after R5 held-out PASS.

chunk_contract.next_chunk: ceil(cumulative_iterations / cumulative_train_seconds * remaining_seconds), clipped to the algorithm-specific bounds

timing_quality_limit: max(0.50 seconds, 5 percent of requested cell budget)

execution.algorithm_order: deterministic rotation by public cell index

decision_rule.unresolved_support_action: repeat a separately frozen longer-budget gate; do not choose post-hoc
decision_rule.mixed_support_leaders: record a support-dependent crossover architecture rather than forcing one universal solver

scope_warning: This physical river-control crossover is required R5/R8 target-machine evidence. It does not by itself mark R5, R6, R8 or READY FOR TABLES as PASS.
